mn103:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kusinārāyaṃ viharati Baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe.
mn103:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn103:2.2: Cīvarahetu vā samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, piṇḍapātahetu vā samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, senāsanahetu vā samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, iti bhavābhavahetu vā samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ desetīti?
mn103:2.3: Na kho no, bhante, Bhagavati evaṃ hoti:
mn103:2.4: Cīvarahetu vā samaṇo Gotamo . . . dhammaṃ desetīti.
mn103:2.5: Na ca kira vo, bhikkhave, mayi evaṃ hoti:
mn103:2.8: Atha kinti vo bhikkhave mayi hotīti?
mn103:2.9: Evaṃ kho no, bhante, Bhagavati hoti:
mn103:2.12: Evaṃ kira vo bhikkhave, mayi hoti:
mn103:3.1: Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, ye vo mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn103:3.2: Cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc' indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, -- tattha sabbeh' eva samaggehi sammodamānehi avivadamānehi sikkhitabbaṃ;
mn103:4.1: tesañ ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ, siyaṃsu dve bhikkhū abhidhamme nānāvādā.
mn103:5.2: Imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato c' eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānan ti; tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:5.3: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c' eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānaṃ,
mn103:5.4: tad aminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:5.5: yathā atthato c' eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānaṃ;
mn103:5.7: Athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:5.8: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c' eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānaṃ,
mn103:5.9: tad aminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:5.10: yathā atthato c' eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānaṃ;
mn103:5.13: duggahītaṃ duggahītato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:6.2: Imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato hi kho nānaṃ byañjanato sametīti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:6.3: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi nānaṃ byañjanato sameti,
mn103:6.4: tad iminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:6.5: yathā atthato hi kho nānaṃ byañjanato sameti;
mn103:6.7: Athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:6.8: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi kho nānaṃ byañjanato sameti,
mn103:6.9: tad iminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:6.10: yathā atthato hi kho nānaṃ byañjanato sameti.
mn103:6.12: Iti duggahītaṃ duggahītato dhāretabbaṃ, sugahītaṃ sugahītato dhāretabbaṃ,
mn103:6.13: duggahītaṃ duggahītato dhāretvā sugahītaṃ sugahītato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:7.2: Imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato hi kho sameti, byañjanato nānan ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataram maññeyyātha so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:7.3: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi sameti, byañjanato nānaṃ,
mn103:7.4: tad iminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:7.5: yathā atthato hi kho sameti byañjanato nānaṃ;
mn103:7.6: appamattakaṃ kho pan' etaṃ yadidaṃ byañjanaṃ; mā
mn103:7.8: Athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:7.9: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi kho sameti byañjanato nānaṃ,
mn103:7.10: tad iminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:7.11: yathā atthato hi kho sameti byañjanato nānaṃ;
mn103:7.12: appamattakaṃ kho pan' etaṃ yadidaṃ byañjanaṃ; mā
mn103:7.14: Iti sugahītaṃ sugahītato dhāretabbaṃ, duggahītaṃ duggahītato dhāretabbaṃ,
mn103:7.15: sugahītaṃ sugahītato dhāretvā duggahītaṃ duggahītato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:8.2: Imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato c' eva sameti byañjanato ca sametīti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:8.3: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c' eva sameti byañjanato ca sameti,
mn103:8.4: tad iminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:8.5: yathā atthato c' eva sameti byañjanato ca sameti;
mn103:8.7: Atthāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:8.8: Āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c' eva sameti byañjanato ca sameti,
mn103:8.9: tad iminā p' etaṃ āyasmanto jānātha,
mn103:8.10: yathā atthato c' eva sameti byañjanato ca sameti;
mn103:8.13: sugahītaṃ sugahītato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
mn103:9.1: Tesañ ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ, siyā aññatarassa bhikkhuno āpatti, siyā vītikkamo.
mn103:10.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, na codanāya taritabbaṃ; puggalo upaparikkhitabbo:
mn103:10.2: Iti mayhañ ca avihesā bhavissati, parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto; paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī adandhadiṭṭhī suppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun ti.
mn103:10.3: Sace, bhikkhave, evam assa, kallaṃ vacanāya.
mn103:11.2: Mayhaṃ kho avihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto; paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī dandhadiṭṭhī suppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
mn103:11.3: Appamattakaṃ kho pan' etaṃ yadidaṃ parassa puggalassa upaghāto.
mn103:11.5: so 'haṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun ti.
mn103:11.6: Sace, bhikkhave, evam assa, kallaṃ vacanāya.
mn103:12.2: Mayhaṃ kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto; paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī adandhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
mn103:12.3: Appamattakaṃ kho pan' etaṃ yadidaṃ mayhaṃ vihesā.
mn103:12.5: so 'haṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun ti.
mn103:12.6: Sace, bhikkhave, evam assa, kallaṃ vacanāya.
mn103:13.2: Mayhaṃ kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto; pāro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī dandhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
mn103:13.3: Appamattakaṃ kho pan' etaṃ yadidaṃ mayhaṃ vihesā parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto.
mn103:13.5: so 'haṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun ti.
mn103:13.6: Sace, bhikkhave, evam assa kallaṃ vacanāya.
mn103:14.2: Mayhaṃ kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto, paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī dandhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, na cāhaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale paṭitthāpetun ti.
mn103:15.1: Tesañ ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ, aññamaññassa vacīsaṃkhāro uppajjeyya diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi.
mn103:15.2: Tattha ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:15.3: Yan no, āvuso, amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ, aññamaññassa vacīsaṃkhāro uppanno diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi, tam jānamāno samaṇo garaheyyāti.
mn103:15.4: Sammā vyākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vyākareyya:
mn103:15.5: Yan no, āvuso, amhākaṃ . . . samaṇo garaheyyāti.
mn103:15.6: Etaṃ pan', āvuso, dhammaṃ appahāyā nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyāti.
mn103:15.7: Sammā vyākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vyākareyya:
mn103:15.8: Etaṃ kho, āvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyāti.
mn103:16.1: Athāparesaṃ ekato pakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
mn103:16.2: Yan no, āvuso, amhākaṃ . . . samaṇo garaheyyāti.
mn103:16.3: Sammā vyākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vyākareyya:
mn103:16.5: Etaṃ pan', āvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyāti.
mn103:16.6: Sammā vyākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vyākaramāno vyākareyya:
mn103:16.7: Etaṃ kho, āvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyāti.
mn103:17.1: Tañ ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ pare evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
mn103:17.2: Āyasmatā no ete bhikkhū akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpitā ti,
mn103:17.3: sammā vyākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vyākareyya:
mn103:17.4: Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃ; tassa me Bhagavā dhammaṃ desesi; tāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhāsiṃ;
mn103:17.5: taṃ te bhikkhū dhammaṃ sutvā akusale vuṭṭhahiṃsu kusale patiṭṭhahiṃsūti.
mn103:17.6: Evaṃ vyākaramāno kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na c' ev' attānaṃ ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vamheti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaroti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
mn103:17.8: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun
